title: Arithmetic mean: a small lesson
goal: Compute the arithmetic mean of a short list of positive integers. Keep this lesson narrowly focused on adding all values and dividing by the number of observations.
priorKnowledge: Can add and divide positive integers. No statistics background.
objective: Compute the arithmetic mean for a short list, show the sum and count, and distinguish the count from the largest value.

sources.title: NIST Engineering Statistics Handbook: definition of the mean
sources.text: The mean is the sum of the data points divided by the number of data points.
